in_sanskrit.name: हसनूर
in_sanskrit.long_meaning: The name Hasanur is derived from the Sanskrit word 'हसन' (hasana) which means 'to laugh' and 'उर' (ura) which means 'man'. The name signifies a handsome and brave man who is capable of making people laugh.

in_hindi.name: हसनूर
in_hindi.long_meaning: The name Hasanur is derived from the Hindi word 'हसनाना' (hasanana) which is a compound of 'हसना' (hasana) which means 'to laugh' and 'नाना' (nana) which means 'many'. The name signifies a person who makes many people laugh.

in_tamil.name: ஹசநூர்
in_tamil.long_meaning: The name Hasanur is derived from the Tamil words 'ஹசன்' (hasan) which means 'handsome' and 'ஊர்' (ur) which means 'man'. The name signifies a handsome man.

in_telugu.name: హెసనూర్
in_telugu.long_meaning: The name Hasanur is derived from the Telugu words 'హెసన్' (hesan) which means 'handsome' and 'ఊర్' (ur) which means 'man'. The name signifies a handsome man.

in_marathi.name: Hasanur
in_marathi.meaning: हिंदू नाव म्हणजे Lord of the serpent
in_marathi.long_meaning: Hasanur हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। Hasanur is a Sanskrit name derived from the Hindu deity Vasuki, who is the king of all serpents and the lord of rain. He holds the rain-giving cloud in his hood, and the gods churned the ocean with his body to obtain the elixir of immortality.
